name: shellport
description: Browser-based SSH client: xterm.js over WebSocket to a server-side SSH proxy, GitHub sign-in, hosts preconfigured in config.json.

scripts.test: npm run build && esbuild test/e2e.test.ts test/unit.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --log-level=warning --outdir=.test-build --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test .test-build/e2e.test.mjs .test-build/unit.test.mjs
scripts.smoke:full: npm run build && esbuild test/smoke/full.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --log-level=warning --outfile=.test-build/smoke-full.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=240000 .test-build/smoke-full.mjs
